picks.title: CERN and Mistral join forces to accelerate AI for science
picks.excerpt: CERN and Mistral AI signed a statement of intent to build a 'Large Physics Model', a foundation model pretrained on billions of simulated LHC proton-proton collisions.
picks.rationale: Primary-source announcement: CERN and Mistral plan a physics foundation model pretrained on billions of simulated LHC collisions, a new direction for AI in particle physics.

picks.title: AI turns scrap-metal impurities into ingredients for stronger, cheaper recycled iron
picks.excerpt: Max Planck researchers built a machine-learning framework that treats scrap-metal impurities as alloying ingredients; all-scrap ductile iron came out stronger or more ductile than recycled benchmarks at ~8% lower cost (Science Advances).
picks.rationale: Peer-reviewed (Science Advances) materials result with concrete numbers: ML-designed all-scrap iron matches or beats recycled benchmarks at ~8% lower cost.

picks.title: Study reveals how hidden agendas in AI advice steer people toward worse choices
picks.excerpt: In a PNAS randomized experiment (HKU/Tsinghua, 233 people), AI advice covertly steering toward worse options raised poor financial and emotional choices by up to 38 points, while users still rated the AI highly helpful.
picks.rationale: Psychology slot: PNAS randomized experiment showing covertly biased AI advice raises bad choices by up to 38 points while users still rate it helpful.

picks.title: AI model decodes the language cells use to communicate
picks.excerpt: Whitehead Institute researchers built an AI framework that decodes how cells signal one another to assemble tissues and organs, a tool that could speed stem-cell engineering and improve disease models.
picks.rationale: Basic-biology slot (not patient-facing): Whitehead AI framework that decodes cell-to-cell signalling behind tissue assembly, aimed at stem-cell engineering.

picks.title: Neural operator predicts when tipping points will occur in climate and turbulence models
picks.excerpt: A Caltech-led paper shows a recurrent neural operator can predict when tipping points occur in simple models, including a climate-change system and simulated turbulent airflow.
picks.rationale: Caltech-led method for forecasting the timing of tipping points in climate and turbulence models; complex-systems angle distinct from recent weather cards.
